examples: Excuse me, I have a food allergy. Do you have gluten-free bread?
I am allergic to nuts, so I need to be very careful with the pastries.
Is it possible to have a vegetarian option for breakfast?
Could you tell me which dishes here are suitable for vegans?
I would like to order a traditional Full English Breakfast, please.
Is there anything local you would recommend I try for breakfast?
Do you have soy milk or oat milk for my coffee? I don't drink dairy.
I'm allergic to eggs. What can I eat from the buffet?
responses: Oh, thank you for telling me! We take allergies very seriously. I can bring you some fresh gluten-free toast from the kitchen.
A Full English! A great choice. I'll tell the chef right away. And don't worry about the nuts, I'll mark your order clearly.
